content: Relation between EndToEndTransformationDescription and EndToEndTransformationComSpecProps It is possible to overwrite the ISignal specific E2E settings that are defined in EndToEndTransformation- Description with settings available in the EndToEndTransformationCom- SpecProps defined at the PortPrototype of a SwComponentType . With this ap- proach it is possible to define Port-Prototype specific configuration options for the E2E data transformer.
